# NeuromorphicInterconnectTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The physical and logical arrangement of connections between neuromorphic cores or chips that supports spike-based communication for real-time neural decoding. This is critical for TCC because the topology determines communication bottlenecks and scalability in distributed neuromorphic systems used for neural decoding.
